subject: [PATCH v1 2/3] fuse: drop rather than zero the copied range in copy_file_range()

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the fuse:copy_file_range() function to use invalidate_inode_pages2_range() instead of truncate_inode_pages_range(). The change is necessary because once file systems support folios larger than a page, truncate_inode_pages_range() can zero out parts of the copied range, leading to data loss. invalidate_inode_pages2_range() drops the entire folio without modifying its contents, which is more suitable for this use case. This patch aims to prevent data corruption and ensure correct behavior in scenarios where file systems support larger-than-page folios.
